rationale: Shanzila is building LLM-based products as CPO at ReachLLM, while Oliver brings deep applied expertise in both computer vision and large language models from roles at Amazon, ObEN, and Kuaishou. Oliver's hands-on experience shipping AI systems (Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow) complements Shanzila's product vision and TypeScript development background, making them strong candidates to explore how cutting-edge AI research translates into product.
intro_message: Shanzila Ahmed, meet Oliver Liu — you're both working at the intersection of LLMs and applied AI, and Oliver's production AI engineering experience could be valuable as you scale ReachLLM's product.
